title: Claude Captain and supervisor SessionStart hooks inject nothing in the Claude desktop app (startup payload omits model)
description: Observed 2026-10-14, session f3819369 (entrypoint claude-desktop, Claude Code 2.1.295, model claude-opus-5-5, source startup). Only bd prime appears in the transcript's SessionStart results; claude-captain-context.mjs and .claude/hooks/supervisor-context.mjs produced no output and no ledger record was written under eshyra-seats/claude-captain/sessions. CLI sessions d1f49350 (2.1.281) and 8b83194c (2.1.296) got all three hooks. Both scripts fail closed on missing/empty input.model (seatContext.mjs classifyClaudeOccupant 'no-model-identity'; supervisor SUPERVISOR_MODEL test). Replaying a startup payload by hand: with model claude-opus-5-5 the supervisor hook emits ~16KB, without model it emits 0 bytes. The model regex (fable|opus) is fine. Most likely cause: the desktop app's Agent-SDK SessionStart payload omits model. NOT YET CONFIRMED: capture a real desktop SessionStart stdin (a temporary capture hook was blocked by the permission classifier) to rule out the alternatives (empty model string, hooks not run). Fix options once confirmed: late admission from the transcript's first assistant message.model (the mechanism PR #591 added for /clear), keeping fail-closed for subagents/unauthorized models; or an explicit operator opt-in. Supervisor hook needs the same treatment. Docs: docs/agent-captain-seats.md 'Occupying a seat'.
notes:
CONFIRMED 2026-10-14: captured a real desktop SessionStart stdin (session 9d540aa6, claude-desktop 2.1.295, source startup). Keys: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, scratchpad_dir, hook_event_name, source. No model key at all. That session's transcript shows message.model claude-opus-5-5, so the session was eligible but unidentifiable at SessionStart. Temporary capture hook removed.
PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/664 (branch eshyra-cjrm-desktop-seat): desktop main sessions admitted regardless of model via process-tree evidence (classifyDesktopHostSession). Personal charter sentence updated. Bead stays in_progress until merge.
close_reason: Merged PR #664 (merge 339487f1): desktop main sessions admitted to Captain seat and supervisor overlay via process-tree evidence
